Clear, confident communicator in English who excels at data storytelling and explains complex topics clearly. A structured, pragmatic, and curious way of working, with an ownership mindset and the ability to stay calm and decisive under pressure. Proficiency in Excel required; SQL and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and project tools (Jira, Confluence) are a plus.
